verdict.rationale: Zoho Books ships built-in AI (Zia) and MCP connectivity, so a training opt-out or no-training data commitment is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents such a control, policy, or commitment. The AI and MCP pages describe AI features, not whether customer data is used for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
